data.body:
Completed ticket 22ec-e638-c896-4b54 (Remove residual blocking-severity guidance after completed severity retirement).

- Researched scope: stale forward-looking blocking-severity claims found in
  src/rebar/review_bot/config.py (module docstring) and docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md
  (operational walkthrough). adapter.py already accurate (no change).
  Historical ADRs 0009 and 0108 correctly retain the retired-knob record --
  confirmed via read and left untouched per ticket's preservation instruction.
- Wrote RED tests in new tests/unit/test_blocking_severity_retirement_docs.py
  (7 tests): maintained-surface census (no live blocking-severity claim),
  ReceiverConfig has no blocking_severities field, gerrit-aws-setup names
  Pass-3 as decision source, historical ADRs retain BLOCKING_SEVERITIES,
  adapter.py unchanged. Confirmed RED via git-stash-revert-and-rerun (3 of 7
  failed as expected before the fix).
- Applied fix: corrected config.py docstring and gerrit-aws-setup.md prose to
  describe the four-pass gate's deterministic Pass-3 blocker
  (criteria_routing.json thresholds) instead of the removed
  blocking-severity threshold.
- Sandboxed mutation test (sandbox-exec macOS profile): reverted the fix,
  confirmed test goes RED, restored -- teeth confirmed.
- make lint clean (one ruff-format fixup on the new test file; regenerated
  docs/env-vars.md for a line-number shift caused by the docstring edit).
- Committed 45bfe47cd838 ("Remove stale blocking-severity claims from docs"),
  pushed to Gerrit as change 2545 (stacked on 2544).

Stack status: 7 changes pushed (2538, 2540, 2541, 2542, 2543, 2544, 2545).
2538 and 2540 confirmed Verified +1; LLM-Review pending on all as of last check.
